title: Senior Market Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Market Manager role at Airbnb .

Airbnb was founded in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home. Since then, it has grown to over 5 million hosts welcoming more than 2 billion guest arrivals worldwide. Hosts offer unique stays and experiences, enabling guests to connect authentically with communities.

The Community You Will Join

Our Field Sales Team is expanding, and we want you to be part of it! As a Senior Market Manager, you will drive the growth and health of our supply in Brazil by managing professional host accounts and acquiring high-quality inventory. Your role focuses on strengthening Airbnb's market presence through collaboration, local expertise, and alignment with our mission and values.

The Difference You Will Make

You will oversee the supply health of key Airbnb markets in Brazil, ensuring a strong presence of high-quality listings. Your role is crucial in expanding our host network, optimizing supply, and driving market growth.

A Typical Day

  1. Build, manage, and grow partner relationships within your territory to exceed quarterly sales targets across 100+ Professional Host accounts.
  2. Conduct optimization calls and business reviews to strengthen partnerships, providing support, including in-person meetings as needed.
  3. Develop strategies to manage and optimize thousands of professional hosts in your region.
  4. Prospect and onboard new high-quality supply in your assigned geography.
  5. Educate clients on product updates and relay feedback internally.
  6. Leverage data to identify growth opportunities, navigate operational complexities, and allocate resources efficiently.
  7. Implement innovative engagement projects using an entrepreneurial approach.
  8. Collaborate cross-functionally with product, communications, public policy, legal, tax, and customer support teams.
  9. Analyze local market trends to inform stakeholders.
  10. Support technical partnerships for a seamless host and guest experience.
  11. Represent Airbnb in external meetings and industry conferences.
  12. Contribute to host community programs to promote growth and engagement.

Your Expertise

  • 10+ years in account management and partner support, with a proven ability to grow business relationships.
  • Success in managing a leads pipeline and a book of business.
  • Strong quantitative skills for data-driven decision-making.
  • Ability to work strategically and tactically in ambiguous environments.
  • Experience in cross-functional collaboration.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Self-starter with strong time management and organizational skills.
  • CRM proficiency (Salesforce experience is a plus).
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus.
  • 2+ years in the tech/travel industry is preferred.
  • Willingness to travel within Brazil and internationally, based in São Paulo.
  • Passion for Airbnb, travel, and the sharing economy; being an Airbnb host is a plus.

Your Location

Based in São Paulo, Brazil. No relocation support provided.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging

We value diverse talent, ideas, and perspectives. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

Want to help us, help others? We’re hiring!

GoFundMe is a global community of over 150 million people who come together every day with the common purpose of helping one another. Our mission is to help people help each other through our best in class technology. In 2022, GoFundMe joined together with Classy , a leading nonprofit fundraising software company that enables nonprofits to connect supporters with the causes they care about. Join us if you're excited to grow both personally and professionally while making a direct impact on GoFundMe’s products, users, and the causes that matter most.

Candidates considered for this role will be located in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

The Job…

  • You’ll play a critical role in driving the strategy for new and innovative products within our Incubation team, aligning with the company's bold vision and growth objectives.
  • You’ll take ownership of the entire product development lifecycle, from ideation to launch and beyond, building solutions that have the potential to reshape the way people interact with financial tools and services.
  • Collaborating closely with engineers, product managers, and designers, you’ll ensure that your solutions are built with precision, scale, and impact.
  • You’ll own the technical roadmap for these new products, prioritizing features based on cutting-edge technology, user needs, and technical feasibility to deliver high-value solutions.
  • Conduct deep technical exploration to stay ahead of industry trends, and leverage that knowledge to design systems that stand up to market demands, while pushing the boundaries of innovation.
  • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for your products, using data-driven insights to iterate, optimize, and enhance the overall user experience and technical performance.

  • You are a seasoned engineer with a track record of building and shipping impactful features. You have 8+ years of relevant experience across various technical domains such as scalable backend systems, complex infrastructure, APIs, or distributed systems.

  • You have experience architecting services and systems using well-accepted design patterns to enable future scaling. You anticipate future use cases and make design decisions that minimize the cost of future change.
  • You are skilled at leading projects from conception to completion, ensuring timely delivery by balancing technical trade-offs and business needs, while communicating progress and challenges to stakeholders, and keeping teams aligned with project goals.
  • You have strong experience in analyzing, diagnosing, and preventing performance problems, with expertise in application performance monitoring and log analytics tools like New Relic and Sumo Logic.
  • Experience in areas such as financial transaction systems, digital wallets, ledgering, reconciliation, compliance (e.g., KYC), and payment infrastructure is a plus.

Preferred...

  • Experience with Spring Boot, Kotlin or Java, AWS, Kafka, Kubernetes.

Why you’ll love it here...

  • Make an Impact: Be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive difference in millions of lives every year.
  • Innovative Environment: Work with a diverse, passionate, and talented team in a fast-paced, forward-thinking atmosphere.
  • Collaborative Team: Join a fun and collaborative team that works hard and celebrates success together.
  • Competitive Benefits: Enjoy competitive pay and comprehensive healthcare benefits.
  • Holistic Support: Enjoy financial assistance for things like hybrid work, family planning, and commuting, along with generous parental leave, flexible time-off policies, and mental health and wellness resources to support your overall well-being.
  • Growth Opportunities: Participate in learning, development, and recognition programs to help you thrive and grow.
  • Commitment to DEI: Contribute to diversity, equity, and inclusion through ongoing initiatives and employee resource groups.
  • Community Engagement: Make a difference through our volunteering and Gives Back programs.

Recentemente, diversificamos nosso portfólio com a inclusão da distribuição de gás natural, através da aquisição da ES Gás E Norgás!



Main responsibilities

Estruturar, coordenar e monitorar processos operacionais, com foco na eficiência, confiabilidade e sustentabilidade das atividades das distribuidoras de gás e energia. Influenciar, disseminar e garantir a continuidade do planejamento da expansão, operação e manutenção das redes de distribuição de gás e/ou energia. Maximizar a rentabilidade dos ativos, garantir a otimização da arquitetura e dimensionamento da rede, garantir a implementação e o cumprimento das políticas de qualidade e eficiência nas operações de construção e manutenção das redes, planos de melhoria contínua e indicadores de desempenho, assegurando o alinhamento entre as metas corporativas e as operações regionais, nos centros de atendimento e nas operações de emergência.

  1. Planejamento Estratégico: Desenvolver planos táticos e estratégicos para as operações das distribuidoras, garantindo eficiência no uso de recursos e alinhamento às metas da holding. Estruturar cenários operacionais e financeiros para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  2. Gestão de Operações: Acompanhar a execução das atividades operacionais, identificando oportunidades de otimização de processos.
  3. Propor soluções que promovam a melhoria contínua e a redução de custos operacionais, sem comprometer a qualidade ou segurança.
  4. Análise de Desempenho: Estabelecer e monitorar indicadores de desempenho operacional (KPIs) para as distribuidoras. Desenvolver relatórios e dashboards para acompanhamento pela alta gestão.
  5. Integração de Processos: Promover sinergias operacionais entre as distribuidoras de gás e energia. Implementar melhores práticas e garantir a padronização dos processos operacionais em toda a holding.
  6. Projetos Especiais: Participar da implementação de projetos estratégicos, como expansão de redes de gás e energia, digitalização de operações e iniciativas de eficiência energética. Coordenar iniciativas de sustentabilidade, priorizando práticas que reduzam impactos ambientais.
  7. Gestão de Riscos: Identificar, avaliar e mitigar riscos relacionados às operações das distribuidoras. Assegurar a conformidade com regulamentações aplicáveis ao setor de gás e energia.
  8. Relacionamento com Stakeholders: Colaborar com lideranças regionais e equipes operacionais para garantir a execução dos planos. Atuar como elo entre a holding e as distribuidoras, assegurando que as diretrizes corporativas sejam implementadas localmente.


Requirements and skills

description:
Direct message the job poster from CHC Navigation | CHCNAV

CHC Navigation is a global provider of innovative GNSS navigation and positioning solutions covering a wide range of professional applications, including land and airborne surveys, conventional GNSS surveys, 3D mass data acquisition, precision farming, unmanned navigation and robotics, real-time GNSS infrastructure, and more.

CHC Navigation is looking for a results-oriented Technical Support Engineer to join its LATAM team and take advantage of a significant growth opportunity in a rapidly expanding company. In this technical and hands-on role, you will ensure that our partners, resellers and clients are successfully trained in demonstrating, installing, and using our agriculture machinery.   • Fluency in Portuguese and professional level of English – written and oral – are mandatory.
  • Possess strong problem-solving skills and excellent analytical skills.
  • Presentation and public speaking skills, including training and technical demonstrations.
  • Comfort with learning new computer applications.

Note: To be considered for this position, candidates must be Brazil citizens, and already living and eligible to work in Brazil.

Travel Requirements

There are some travels required in this role - including travel to a business partner or customer locations, trade shows, visit strategic accounts, other regional trips to support CHCNAV LATAM team.

What we offer

  • A job in an international result-oriented company where you can make full use of your skills.

title: Ubuntu Core Software Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Ubuntu Core Software Engineer role at Canonical

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Ubuntu Core Software Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Ubuntu Core Software Engineer to redefine the Linux experience in the embedded environments with the smallest, most secure, and updatable operating system in the IoT market. This is an opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, security, and the developer experience. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill with low-level operating systems, kernel, and device firmware.
Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardise the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.
As an Ubuntu Core team member, you'll be designing and implementing software that runs on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will work on boot mechanisms, bootloaders, storage partition layout, device trees, kernel and services.
Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.
Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region
The role entails

  • Write high quality code with unit tests to create new features
  • Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Integrate diverse bootloaders and maintain gadget snaps
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 times a year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with C or Golang, and Shell
  • You have a solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • You have personal or professional experience with Linux-capable devices such as Raspberry Pi
  • You have interest in learning or experience in one or more low-level systems and security facilities such as:
    • Bootloaders in ARM and X86, such as piboot, uboot, grub-uefi
    • Systemd and units, udev, initrd, graphics
    • OS level firmware daemons and CLI applications
    • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.
  • You may have experience or knowledge of Yocto
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity , we will give your application fair consideration.

Role Description:

Our Immigration Consultants are responsible for helping corporations and private clients successfully complete the relevant immigration process so that they are able to live and work around the world. They develop a strong service relationship with clients upon contact to ensure that each case is handled expediently, accurately, and consistent with global standards. A key part of the role is to liaise directly with clients, understanding their situation and ensuring the appropriate solutions. Our Consultants use their commercial and professional expertise to provide prompt, high quality, tailored advice and guidance based on individual client needs. We help ensure clients obtain the relevant visas, work permits, visa extensions, settlement and passport and nationality papers in a smooth and stress-free manner.

Consultants enjoy the opportunity to regularly communicate with clients and relevant authorities by email or telephone, while also ensuring adherence to strict deadlines. The Immigration team and our customers come from different cultural and nationality backgrounds and this adds to the variety and diversity of our work. In return, CIBT will provide you with an interesting and varied role, career opportunities and the ability to contribute directly to the success of a rapidly growing business.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Carrying out volume casework for assigned countries, including case initiation, case assessment, provision of advice on applicable rules and procedures, case preparation and submission, monitoring progress and follow up on completion.
  • Acts as dedicated point of contact to clients, providing highly personalized services that meet client needs. Takes ownership of client relationship and provides clients with informed advice that reflects best practices and compliance. Conducts regular review of accounts, assists with training for corporate clients
  • Works closely and seamlessly with Network Partner/Attorney, where applicable, to support client needs – within casework to coordinate strategy, hold assessment and introductory calls, review materials and case product, align on processing and case updates
  • Monitoring application deadlines and completing assigned work within the appropriate timeframes.
  • Using sound judgement in assessing client risk and escalating potential issues to senior management in a timely manner.
  • Taking care to consider alternatives and delivering appropriate decisions with minimal senior management involvement.
  • Monitoring visa expiry dates and alerting the client appropriately.
  • Ensuring that the appropriate client records are established and maintained and that key correspondence and documentation is saved into the client e-file.
  • Ensuring that all work undertaken is in scope, is billed promptly on completion, and that additional fees are agreed in advance for additional services. Ensuring that use of the corporate credit card is recorded in an accurate and timely fashion and within the associated case, where applicable. Listens intently to the client needs to ensure that these needs are met and anticipating customer needs, offering pro-active advice. Remaining updated on industry events/circumstances that may be relevant to the client.
  • Communicating regularly with clients to build a strong relationship while focusing on business needs and ensuring that client service review meetings are held regularly, with formal agendas and presentations
  • Attends client meetings, telephone & video conferences/ webinars as required.
  • Identifying, pursuing and generating new business leads, ensuring that work is profitable.
  • Using exceptional organizational skills to meet or exceed customer expectations (including where SLAs are in place). Responding to email and telephone enquiries in a timely manner and ensuring that advice is comprehensive and accurate, managing expectations where needed and escalating issues promptly and appropriately.
  • Utilizing resources and researching complex cases/scenarios.
  • Recommending improvements in work procedures, policies or systems in area of assigned responsibility.
  • Ensuring the client receives appropriate news updates and alerts.
  • Personal involvement with seminars, webinars, internal and external networking events etc.
  • Guiding and training junior team members in identifying and assessing client risk.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field, plus 3 years of experience or Associate’s degree plus 5 years of experience in related field.
  • Speak and write in English proficiently, professionally, and objectively.
  • Ability to manage time effectively by prioritizing, identifying and addressing critical tasks, while remaining flexible to changing priorities.
  • Ability to work with professionalism, honesty and integrity maintaining confidentiality at all times and to model the company values.

description:
Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga

Garantir a aplicação das normas e diretrizes de Saúde, Segurança do Trabalho e Meio Ambiente (SSMA) a bordo das embarcações da frota fluvial, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho seguro, saudável e em conformidade com as legislações vigentes, normas internas e boas práticas do setor. Atuar de forma preventiva, orientando e monitorando os tripulantes quanto às práticas seguras de operação e convivência a bordo.

Principais Atividades:

  • Acompanhar as operações da frota fluvial, garantindo o cumprimento dos procedimentos de segurança e meio ambiente;
  • Realizar inspeções periódicas nas embarcações para identificar riscos, propor ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Investigar incidentes e acidentes a bordo, elaborando relatórios e planos de ação;
  • Promover treinamentos, DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança), simulados de emergência e campanhas educativas voltadas à segurança, saúde e meio ambiente;
  • Monitorar o uso de EPI/EPC e garantir a correta aplicação dos procedimentos operacionais e de segurança;
  • Apoiar a gestão de resíduos e controle ambiental a bordo;
  • Manter atualizados os documentos e registros relacionados ao SSMA, conforme exigências legais e internas;
  • Prestar suporte técnico às lideranças de bordo e aos tripulantes, incentivando a cultura de segurança e prevenção.

Requisitos:

  • Formação Técnica em Segurança do Trabalho com registro ativo no MTE;
  • Experiência prévia em atividades de segurança do trabalho embarcado ou em operações fluviais/maritmas será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre normas regulamentadoras (NRs), especialmente aplicáveis ao ambiente embarcado (NR-30, NR-29, entre outras);
  • Habilidades em elaboração de relatórios, inspeções e treinamentos;
  • Boa comunicação, proatividade e capacidade de atuação preventiva;
  • Disponibilidade para regime de trabalho 22 dias embarcado por 10 dias de folga .

Informações adicionais:

  • Conhecimento em gestão ambiental;
  • Cursos voltados à segurança em ambientes embarcados (ex.: HUET, CBSP, etc.);
  • Carteira de Habilitação categoria B;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão SSMA (ex.: SSO, ISM Code, ISO 45001, ISO 14001).

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

What we are looking for
  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, with 5+ years in Azure environments
  • Expertise in Azure infrastructure, networking, and security, including VNets, Front Door, WAF, Firewalls (Premium + IDPS), VPN, DNS, AD, App Service, Container Apps, Function Apps, Event Hub, Defender, and Sentinel
  • Preferred experience administering Azure AD B2C, with deep understanding of identity and authentication security best practices

  • Expertise in Application Performance Monitoring (APM) with Datadog strongly preferred, including real-time alerting and troubleshooting

  • Strong database administration experience with Azure SQL Server, including cloud-based backup, replication, and high-availability strategies. Experience with the Hyperscale service tier is a strong plus.
  • Experience with disaster recovery, incident management, and high-availability architectures
  • Deep understanding of DevSecOps principles, including security compliance, role-based access control, and vulnerability management
  • Proficiency in Git and GitHub for version control and workflow automation
  • Experience in optimizing cloud costs (FinOps) and monitoring usage trends.
  • Ability to thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced remote work environment, handling multiple projects simultaneously

Responsibilities
  • Manage and optimize Azure infrastructure, networking, security, and identity management, ensuring compliance with SOC 2 and industry best practices
  • Ensure customer-facing systems maintain high availability and rapid incident response, including automated failover and disaster recovery strategies
  • Maintain and enhance Azure Pipelines for seamless CI/CD workflows, integrating automated security, unit, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Implement and manage Terraform for infrastructure automation
  • Own the Datadog APM ecosystem, implementing best practices for monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and compliance
  • Implement DevSecOps practices, including security scanning, role-based access controls (RBAC), and proactive threat mitigation using Azure Defender and Sentinel
  • Continuously monitor Azure cost trends, implementing FinOps strategies to optimize cloud expenses while maintaining performance and security
  • Administer and enhance Azure AD B2C, ensuring secure authentication and identity management
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring data integrity and business continuity
  • Work closely with Engineering and Security teams, documenting best practices, infrastructure changes, and operational procedures
Company Benefits
  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

title: Senior Hardware Certifications Engineer
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Senior Hardware Certifications Engineer, your job is to excel at standard operating procedures and quality management systems, like those required by regulatory agencies such as UL, FCC, IFT, ANATEL, INMETRO, and IEC. You will work alongside our best engineers on developing and adapting our devices to meet strict international criteria, aiding the company in its mission to modernize the factory floor worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Ensuring our hardware components and systems comply with industry standards and regulations
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including hardware engineering, manufacturing, and product management, to ensure certification guidelines are followed throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Coordinate and execute certification tests, both in-house and with external laboratories, to verify compliance with relevant standards.
  • Generate comprehensive test plans, protocols, and reports to document certification efforts and outcomes.
  • Work closely with hardware engineering, firmware engineering, and software engineering teams to ensure alignment of design and development activities with certification goals.
  • Identify and interpret applicable certification requirements and develop strategies to achieve and maintain compliance.
,

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in hardware certification.
  • Expertise in FCC, CE, IFT, UL Markings, IEC, and other regulatory compliance standards.
  • Experience with IECEx, ATEX, and other hazardous locations certifications.
  • Strong understanding of safety and functioning electronics standards and certifications such as IEC 61010 and IEC 61557-12.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 procedures and requirements.
  • Experience with EMC, IME and other RF compliance tests.
  • Fluent English proficiency.
,

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with HALT and ALT testing (temperature, humidity, vibration, etc.).
  • Experience with calibration and accuracy standards such as ISO 17025.
  • Fluent Spanish proficiency.
Compensation:
  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Employee Giving
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Day off during the week of your birthday
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities

title: ANALISTA PLANEJAMENTO COMERCIAL - CORPORATIVO - CASA PRADO
description:
É tempo de ser marcante!!

Somos uma marca especialista em moda masculina!

Propósito da marca : Elevar a autoestima das pessoas!

Estamos em busca de profissionais que não se contentam com um simples emprego, mas que enxergam no trabalho um constante desafio. Se você é uma pessoa movida pela paixão por encontrar soluções, inovar e alcançar resultados, essa é a oportunidade para você! Procuramos alguém com atitude imbatível, comprometimento e uma mentalidade voltada para o crescimento. Se você é determinado, busca sempre a excelência e tem o desejo de fazer a diferença no planejamento comercial, queremos conhecê-lo!

Você busca uma oportunidade, nós buscamos o seu talento!

Quais serão os seus desafios?

  • Analisar o desempenho de vendas da empresa, coletando e interpretando dados de vendas, identificando tendências e oportunidades de melhoria, para fornecer insights que subsidiem a tomada de decisões estratégicas de vendas.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar o plano de vendas da empresa, definindo metas de vendas por produto, região e canal, monitorando o desempenho em relação às metas e propondo ajustes quando necessário, para garantir o alcance dos objetivos de vendas da empresa.
  • Realizar análises de mercado, estudando o comportamento dos consumidores, a concorrência e as tendências do mercado, para identificar oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolver estratégias de vendas eficazes.
  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos de previsão de vendas, utilizando técnicas estatísticas e ferramentas de análise de dados, para prever a demanda futura e otimizar o planejamento de produção e estoque.
  • Monitorar e analisar os indicadores de desempenho de vendas (KPIs), como volume de vendas, margem de lucro, participação de mercado e taxa de conversão, para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e acompanhar o progresso em relação às metas.
  • Realizar análises de rentabilidade de produtos e clientes, identificando os produtos e clientes mais rentáveis e propondo ações para otimizar a rentabilidade da empresa.
  • Elaborar relatórios e apresentações gerenciais, consolidando dados de vendas, análises de mercado e previsões de vendas, para fornecer informações claras e concisas para a tomada de decisões da equipe de vendas e da alta gestão.
  • Colaborar com as áreas de marketing, produtos e finanças, fornecendo informações e análises que subsidiem o desenvolvimento de estratégias de marketing, o lançamento de novos produtos e o planejamento financeiro da empresa.
  • Acompanhar a performance das campanhas de vendas, analisando os resultados das campanhas, identificando os canais e ações mais eficazes e propondo ajustes para otimizar o retorno sobre o investimento.
  • Identificar e analisar oportunidades de expansão de mercado, avaliando o potencial de novos mercados, canais de vendas e parcerias estratégicas, para contribuir para o crescimento da empresa.

Requisitos:

  • Superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Ciência de dados, Estatística ou qualquer formação que seja compatível com as atribuições do cargo.

Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco;

  • Plataforma de terapia online;

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
At Infobip, we dream big. We value creativity, persistence, and innovation, passionately believing that it is through teamwork that we can all reach greater heights.


Since 2006, we have been innovating at the edge of technological possibilities and are now shaping global communications of the future. Through 75+ offices on six continents, Infobip’s platform is used by almost 80% of the population, making it the largest network of its kind and the only full-stack cloud communication platform globally.


Join us on our mission to create life-changing interactions between humans and online services with new and unseen solutions.

A Solution Engineer is an individual contributor role in the region that plays a vital role in crafting exceptional customer experiences by delivering tailored solutions and nurturing innovation. The engineer in this role participates in the activities for Infobip’s solution proposals, owns the solution design, delivery and integrations, improvement of the current solutions . To deliver the desired business results, Solution Engineers collaborate with the HQ and regional teams and act as technical opportunity leads or assist the more experienced colleagues . They independently manage opportunities from initiation to delivery.

A Solution Engineer can act as a generalis t and perform all the activities listed below, or can be specialized in one or more areas, such as CX consultancy, partnership s , solution and product or industry specialization.

Help customers and /or partners understand the value of Infobip solutions and services

Understand the customers’ businesses, knowing exactly which of our solutions and products can help them evolve their business

Design new and innovative solutions to meet customers ’ business needs

Collect the technical requirements and design technical solutions and service integration plans

Handle technical and security questionnaires

Conduct captivating demos and POCs

Conduct scoping exercises and provide service quote estimation

Implement solutions for new and existing customers

Deliver comprehensive and precise technical documentation

Configure/customize Infobip solutions to meet customer’s business requirements

Ensure all projects are delivered on time, within scope and budget, and exceeding customer expectations

Conduct consulting and solution enablement sessions for customers and document with meeting minutes summaries.

Contribute to internal initiatives and focus on continuous development

Document solutions and best practices and share them within the department.

Have an overview of market feature requirements and provide feedback to steer the development of products’ features

Maintain a comprehensive understanding of Infobip's products and solutions, both technically and commercially, staying updated on changes and upgrades.

Bachelor's Degree on System, telecommunication or electronic engineering.

Fluent/Advanced English is mandatory

Experience with Client Facing either in commercial or technical conversations.

About Payoneer
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 markets.

As an HR Business Partner (HRBP), you will be a strategic advisor to senior functional leaders, translating business goals into people strategies and helping shape high-performing, inclusive, and scalable teams. You’ll partner closely with People Partners, COEs, and the HRBP leadership team to ensure your business area is aligned, engaged, and supported across performance, talent, structure, and change. title: Manager Americas - Customer Success
description:

Join to apply for the Manager Americas - Customer Success role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Manager Americas - Customer Success role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Customer Success Regional Team Manager.
To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to help our team of Customer Success Managers across regions. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success and an obvious passion for new technologies. Ideally, you have been a Customer Success Manager at one point in your career and naturally evolved to a leading position.
You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you are to provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and quickly adapt to changes. You seek collaboration with other teams to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility is to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work hand-in-hand with the Head of Customer Success.
CSMs engage a diverse customer base and follow diverse CSM motions to provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer. The right candidate would adapt to this diversity and bring broad experience to the team.
Location: This is a globally remote role
The role entails:

  • Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, Team Meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive upsells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
  • Customer interactions and support to your team: you resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention. You work closely with your team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Team management: you are passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. You are ready for regular performance reviews with team members. While your help in identifying areas for improvement is key, you are asked to celebrate excellence, recognise your team's achievements, and set goals for individual growth within the team.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
  • Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.
What we are looking for in you
  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
  • Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
  • Experience growing and developing a CSM team
  • Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Product owner
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner altamente motivado e focado em resultados para liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras de crédito com garantias. O candidato ideal será responsável por definir e priorizar o backlog de produtos, trabalhar diretamente com as equipes de desenvolvimento e garantir que nossas soluções atendam às necessidades dos clientes e do negócio. Além disso, terá um papel fundamental na validação de hipóteses, utilizando testes e experimentos para tomar decisões baseadas em dados e aprimorar continuamente o produto.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Definir e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo que as funcionalidades entreguem valor ao cliente e ao negócio.
  • Colaborar com as partes interessadas internas (executivos, marketing, vendas, suporte ao cliente) para alinhamento da visão do produto e definição de prioridades.
  • Desenvolver e conduzir testes e experimentos para validar hipóteses de funcionalidades, utilizando abordagens como testes A/B, MVPs (Produto Mínimo Viável) e outras técnicas de validação.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio e de usuários em histórias claras e detalhadas para o time de desenvolvimento, com critérios de aceitação bem definidos.
  • Monitorar e analisar os resultados de testes para determinar o sucesso das hipóteses e ajustar o backlog com base em dados concretos e insights obtidos.
  • Gerenciar o roadmap do produto, garantindo que as entregas estejam alinhadas às necessidades estratégicas da empresa e do mercado.
  • Trabalhar com a metodologia ágil (Scrum/Kanban), liderando cerimônias como refinamento de backlog, sprint planning e revisões de sprint.
  • Validar as entregas com base nos critérios de aceitação e feedback de usuários, garantindo que os produtos estejam prontos para o lançamento.
  • Monitorar o desempenho do produto pós-lançamento, coletando feedback de usuários e analisando métricas para guiar melhorias contínuas.
  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado e análise de concorrentes, identificando oportunidades para inovação e crescimento.
  • Ser a ponte entre o time de desenvolvimento e os stakeholders, garantindo comunicação clara e transparente sobre o progresso do produto e suas métricas.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou em funções de gestão de produtos digitais, preferencialmente em fintechs ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Habilidade para desenvolver e validar hipóteses de produto através de experimentos controlados, como testes A/B, protótipos e MVPs.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e experiência em liderar equipes de desenvolvimento.
  • Forte entendimento do mercado de crédito, especialmente crédito com garantias, e das tendências regulatórias e tecnológicas que o impactam.
  • Habilidade em priorizar funcionalidades com base em impacto de negócios, valor para o usuário e complexidade técnica.
  • Experiência em analisar dados e métricas de produtos para tomar decisões baseadas em resultados de experimentos e feedbacks de usuários.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e liderança, com capacidade de colaborar com equipes multifuncionais e gerenciar expectativas de stakeholders.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de backlog e projetos, como Jira, Trello, ou Asana.
  • Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

title: Cloud Field Engineering Manager
description:

Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

This is an opportunity to run a field engineering team, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions in public clouds and in their own data centers. We work across the entire spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu itself to virtualisation and private cloud, Kubernetes, and the implementation of sophisticated open source solutions such as MLops platforms, data platforms and more. We are rapidly expanding the range of open source solutions we offer and deliver to customers, as we move into new industries like telco, finance, health care and media we design and develop new open source solutions to meet their needs.
We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should feel completely at home troubleshooting technical issues and having technical presales conversations with customers. They should contribute to project delivery themselves, but know that the technical contributions they bring are far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team's direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers, who are interested in soft skills, to be managers.
We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of 'most software to most companies'. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.
The role of a Cloud Field Engineering Manager at Canonical
The Field Engineering team is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc. The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process.
A Cloud Field Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals.
Location: This role will be home based, managing a team in your time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies, such as Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph, etc.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • Experience in technical presales
  • You are a dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Passion and a track record of developing and growing people
  • Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring engineers
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and, preferably, university as well
  • Willingness to travel up to 40% of the time. Field Engineers attend internal company events, external tech events and customer meetings.
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • Second language - Spanish or French preferred
  • Python knowledge
  • Experience collaborating with external partners
  • Experience collaborating with several internal teams and providing stakeholder feedback for engineering roadmaps
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Analista fiscal de contabilidade
description:
O cargo de Analista Fiscal em uma empresa de contabilidade envolve a responsabilidade por atividades relacionadas à apuração e controle de tributos, com foco no cumprimento das obrigações fiscais e tributárias das empresas clientes. O analista fiscal desempenha um papel fundamental na gestão das obrigações fiscais, garantindo que os tributos sejam calculados corretamente e pagos dentro dos prazos estabelecidos pela legislação.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Apuração de Tributos: Calcular e controlar tributos como ICMS, IPI, ISS, PIS, COFINS, IRPJ, CSLL, entre outros, conforme a legislação vigente.
  2. Preenchimento de Obrigações Acessórias: Elaborar e transmitir as declarações fiscais, como DCTF, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contribuições, DIRF, entre outras.
  3. Análise de Documentos Fiscais: Verificar a regularidade dos documentos fiscais recebidos (notas fiscais de entrada e saída), garantindo que os mesmos estejam de acordo com as exigências legais.
  4. Consultoria Fiscal: Prestar suporte e orientação aos clientes sobre questões fiscais, como o enquadramento tributário mais vantajoso, mudanças na legislação e procedimentos para regularização de pendências fiscais.
  5. Apuração de Impostos Diretos e Indiretos: Realizar a apuração de impostos sobre a produção e circulação de mercadorias e serviços, bem como impostos sobre a renda e contribuições.
  6. Controle de Créditos e Débitos Fiscais: Gerenciar os créditos tributários gerados pelas compras e serviços prestados e garantir que sejam utilizados corretamente para compensação de tributos devidos.
  7. Acompanhamento de Mudanças na Legislação Fiscal: Manter-se atualizado sobre as mudanças na legislação tributária e fiscal, implementando as alterações necessárias nos processos da empresa e repassando as informações para os clientes.
  8. Acompanhamento de Auditorias Fiscais: Auxiliar na preparação para auditorias fiscais, garantindo que toda a documentação e os registros estejam em conformidade.
  9. Regularização de Pendências Fiscais: Auxiliar na negociação de parcelamentos e regularização de pendências fiscais com o fisco.

Requisitos:

  1. Formação: Ensino superior completo em Contabilidade, Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  2. Conhecimentos: Domínio das obrigações fiscais e tributárias, sistemas de gestão contábil e fiscal, SPED, EFD, DCTF, entre outras ferramentas.
  3. Experiência: Experiência prévia em escritórios de contabilidade, departamentos fiscais ou em empresas de grande porte.
  4. Habilidades: Atenção aos detalhes, organização, capacidade analítica e habilidades de comunicação.

Esse cargo exige profissional com boa capacidade de análise, habilidades para lidar com a legislação tributária complexa e uma comunicação eficaz, além de ser um elo importante entre a empresa e o fisco.

title: Concept Artist
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is seeking an experienced Concept Artist to join our team working on Fortnite, Rocket League, and Rocket Racing. A successful candidate should possess a strong sense of vehicle design, knowledge of 3D software, and a solid foundation in art theories. Must be a team player and demonstrate the ability to be self-motivated and work autonomously. The role involves working closely with the Art Director and Lead Concept Artist to create appealing vehicle designs and environments. The candidate will collaborate with the art team to implement and sustain the creative vision for the game.

In this role, you will

  1. Produce artwork encompassing all facets of development, including vehicle designs, environments, props, VFX exploration, pitch concepts, and marketing materials based on direction from Art Director, Lead Concept, and input from the game design team.
  2. Based on visual direction from the Art Director, collaborate on the visual style and ensure our designs are of Epic quality bar create and iterate unique and stunning designs within a determined production schedule.
  3. A versatile artist capable of executing a variety of styles and able to pivot based on the needs of the project.
  4. Collaborate with other discipline teams to produce a cohesive game experience.

What we're looking for

  1. An eye for modern automotive aesthetics that speak to our audience of teens and young adults.
  2. Ability to work within gameplay design restraints (environment scale, character abilities, prototype function, etc.) and translate those restrictions into visuals that enhance the experience.
  3. Experience creating art from mechanical designs to exciting arena sports environments.
  4. Experience in 3D software such as Maya, Blender, and/or Zbrush.
  5. Excellent foundation skills, including composition, design, and color theory, and advanced knowledge of industrial design.
  6. Experienced in working with external outsourcing vendors.
  7. An excellent understanding of art pipelines.
  8. Strong communication skills and understanding of various art disciplines.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs

Responsibilities

A oportunidade

Planejar, controlar e executar atividades de Saúde Ocupacional, Segurança do Trabalho e Meio Ambiente da unidade de Feira de Santana, com o objetivo de garantir a segurança dos colaboradores e cumprimento da legislação aplicável.

O seu impacto

  • Inspecionar locais, instalações e equipamentos da empresa, observando as condições de trabalho, para determinar fatores e riscos de acidentes.
  • Investigar acidentes ocorridos, examinando as condições da ocorrência, para identificar suas causas e propor as providências cabíveis.
  • Registrar irregularidades ocorridas, anotando-as em formulários próprios e elaborando estatísticas de acidentes, para obter subsídios destinados à melhoria das medidas de segurança. Instruir os funcionários da empresa sobre normas de segurança, combate a incêndios e demais medidas de prevenção de acidentes.Acompanhar o recebimento, armazenamento, transporte, manuseio e expedição de substâncias tóxicas, produtos inflamáveis, obras civis, observando aplicação de normas e procedimentos de segurança no trabalho.
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos procedimentos do GEHSMS - Gestão global de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente.

Qualifications

Quem estamos buscando?

  • Conhecimento básico das NR's.
  • Conhecimento básico no pacote office
  • Conhecimento das ferramentas básicas de gestão de riscos
  • Conhecimento das ferramentas de investigação de acidentes

Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.

Coordenadora/Coordenador de Integridade e Confiabilidade Filtragem - Vaga exclusiva para pessoas negras

Está em busca de um futuro emocionante? Então, nós temos uma excelente oportunidade.

Na Anglo American, acreditamos em resultados extraordinários. Isso significa que estamos sempre procurando novas e melhores maneiras de fazer as coisas, forjando um novo curso em nosso setor para maior eficiência, zero dano e maior sustentabilidade.

Guiados por nosso objetivo e valores, promovemos alto desempenho e ação com propósito, pois nosso objetivo é "Reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas", fornecendo metais e minerais que possibilitam a vida moderna, desde telefones a medicamentos.

Estamos transformando nossas operações questionando o pensamento existente e aplicando novas ideias e avanços tecnológicos para enfrentar os principais desafios da mineração. Inovamos com um objetivo: buscar novas maneiras de trabalhar que sejam mais seguras e responsáveis, focando na saúde e bem-estar de nossos colegas e das comunidades onde atuamos.

No Brasil, atuamos com dois negócios: Minério de ferro, com Minas-Rio, localizado em Minas Gerais e Rio de Janeiro; e Níquel, com operações em Barro Alto e Niquelândia, Goiás. Além disso, temos uma estrutura corporativa em Belo Horizonte.

Estamos buscando talentos que compartilhem nossos valores e crença em um futuro melhor, mais seguro, diverso e respeitoso para a mineração. Você pode ser um deles!

Como Coordenador(a) de Integridade e Confiabilidade Filtragem , você será responsável por coordenar os processos de priorização, planejamento e execução das atividades de integridade estrutural da filtragem, realizados por equipe própria e terceirizada. Também garantirá a disponibilidade, integridade e desempenho dos ativos da planta, aplicando metodologias de confiabilidade (RCM, FMEA, análise de falhas) e estratégias de manutenção preditiva e preventiva. Atuará na identificação e mitigação de riscos operacionais, desenvolvendo planos de manutenção baseados na criticidade, liderando investigações de falhas, propondo melhorias técnicas e coordenando inspeções técnicas especializadas. Trabalhará de forma integrada com áreas de engenharia, operação e segurança, assegurando conformidade com normas técnicas, desempenho sustentável dos equipamentos e suporte à tomada de decisão com base em dados e indicadores de performance.

Veja abaixo as principais atividades:

  1. Coordenar a equipe de preditiva e planejamento, além da execução de atividades relacionadas à integridade estrutural.
  2. Elaborar e manter planos de integridade baseados na criticidade dos ativos e na segurança.
  3. Investigar falhas estruturais ou mecânicas, conduzindo análises de falha e elaboração de planos de ação corretivos.
  4. Definir e revisar estratégias de manutenção baseada em condição (CBM), utilizando vibração, ultrassom, termografia, entre outros.
  5. Avaliar a criticidade estrutural dos ativos e priorizar intervenções conforme matriz de risco.
  6. Aplicar ferramentas como RCM (Reliability Centered Maintenance) e FMEA para melhorar a disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos equipamentos.
  7. Acompanhar KPIs como MTBF, MTTR, disponibilidade estrutural, backlog de manutenção, número de inspeções realizadas versus planejadas, etc.
  8. Capacitar a equipe de manutenção e operação em práticas seguras e eficazes para garantir a integridade dos ativos.
  9. Manter atualizados desenhos, laudos de inspeção, relatórios de integridade, certificados e históricos de manutenção.
  10. Atuar proativamente junto à operação para reportar anomalias e mitigar riscos à segurança e continuidade operacional.
  11. Colaborar na elaboração e controle do orçamento de manutenção e inspeção de ativos estruturais e de confiabilidade.
  12. Implementar melhorias contínuas nos processos de manutenção e operação.
  13. Coordenar a equipe, realizando controle de ponto, reuniões de feedback, análises de promoções e movimentações salariais, entre outras atividades de gestão.
  14. Cumprir as políticas e procedimentos de Segurança, Saúde Operacional, Meio Ambiente, Responsabilidade Social e Integridade Empresarial da Anglo American.

O perfil que buscamos:

  • Ensino Superior em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção ou Automação.
  • Desejável Mestrado em Engenharia de Manutenção, Pós-graduação em Engenharia de Manutenção ou Estruturas.

Por que fazer parte do nosso time?

Somos uma empresa comprometida em transformar nossas crenças e valores em ações concretas. Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho de qualidade, diverso e seguro, onde você pode desenvolver seu potencial. Conheça nossos benefícios:

  • Para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental: Gympass, Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (para você e dependentes), Assistência Psicológica e Aplicativo Saúde Emocional.
  • Para sua família: Auxílio Creche, Programa Família, Brinquedo de Natal e Vale Alimentação.
  • Espaço para ser você mesmo: participação em Grupos de Afinidades e eventos da Semana da Diversidade.
  • Plano de Previdência Privada, transporte fretado, refeições no local, remuneração variável, Seguro de Vida, apoio jurídico, financeiro, social e psicológico.

Compromisso com sua segurança:

Priorizamos sua segurança, investindo em tecnologias e seguindo rigorosos padrões de segurança para garantir que você volte para casa em segurança após o trabalho.

Inclusão e Diversidade:

Valorizamos e respeitamos todas as identidades e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, com Grupos de Afinidades para discutir e promover ações de diversidade e inclusão.

Queremos colegas que se sintam valorizados, respeitados e confiantes para trazer seu verdadeiro eu ao trabalho.

Job description

Todas as pessoas candidatas qualificadas serão consideradas para nossa vaga, sem distinção de etnia, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, idade, nacionalidade ou deficiência. Promovemos constantemente uma cultura voltada para inclusão da diversidade, incentivando nossas pessoas colaboradoras a contribuírem com o seu melhor. Nosso bem mais precioso são as pessoas, por isso a Unicred do Brasil promove a igualdade nas suas oportunidades!

Nosso modelo de trabalho na Unicred segue no formato híbrido, com atuação presencial, dois dias por semana, na sede da instituição.

Atualmente nossas sedes estão localizadas em Porto Alegre e São Paulo e contam com ambientes multifuncionais, que promovem maior interação, troca de experiências e colaboração.

Também possuímos posições no modelo remoto/home office para profissionais que residem em outras regiões do Brasil.

Focamos em vivências inspiradoras para uma jornada de crescimento e inovação.

Se identificou? Então vem cooperar conosco!


Main responsibilities

  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vida dos normativos da Diretoria, com foco na atualização tempestiva, no controle de vigência, na aprovação formal e na divulgação institucional, assegurando que os responsáveis conduzam as etapas conforme os prazos e diretrizes estabelecidos;
  • Promover a visibilidade das políticas e normativos de riscos junto às cooperativas, avaliando o grau de conhecimento, engajamento e aderência;
  • Propor mecanismos de comunicação mais eficazes e intuitivos, fortalecendo o entendimento da importância das políticas e normativos em todos os níveis organizacionais;
  • Monitorar a execução orçamentária das gerências, comparando valores orçados versus realizados e possíveis desvios;
  • Estruturar relatórios executivos e dashboards, com visualização inteligente e direcionada à tomada de decisão;
  • Implementar e consolidar uma metodologia de definição, acompanhamento e revisão contínua de OKRs da Diretoria;
  • Garantir visibilidade, consistência e integração dos OKRs com os objetivos organizacionais, promovendo cultura de alta performance;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar os projetos Cross/estratégicos da Diretoria, com destaque para iniciativas como o Programa Convergir e Relatório Integrado de Riscos, promovendo alinhamento, monitoramento e suporte as iniciativas;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente os projetos, por meio de revisão crítica, sugestões qualificadas e contribuições orientadas à excelência de entrega;
  • Manter atualizada a apresentação institucional, organogramas e estruturas formais da Diretoria de Riscos;
  • Colaborar para fortalecer a imagem da Diretoria, alinhando missão, visão, valores e narrativas institucionais à estratégia corporativa;
  • Desenvolver materiais/apresentações de alta qualidade para interlocução com diferentes públicos (internos e externos);
  • Apoiar a Diretoria na organização e qualificação das pautas de reuniões do Conselho, Comitê de Risco, Direx e demais fóruns;
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e de governança, auxiliando no acompanhamento das ações, entregas e compromissos estabelecidos;
  • Inventariar, avaliar e promover a governança dos dashboards de risco disponíveis;
  • Identificar BIs obsoletos, inativos ou em duplicidade, propondo racionalização, modernização e análise de uso e impacto;
  • Acompanhar e avaliar a efetividade do Programa de Cultura de Riscos, incluindo adesão aos EAD e percepção de valor pelos públicos-chave;
  • Propor ações de aprimoramento contínuo e mobilização cultural;
  • Entender o grau de envolvimento e maturidade das áreas de negócio no processo de gestão de riscos, identificando lacunas, pontos críticos e oportunidades de fortalecimento da atuação da primeira linha;
  • Identificar as reais necessidades das áreas quanto a ferramentas, metodologias, estrutura e capacitação para exercer com autonomia e efetividade seu papel na gestão de riscos;
  • Avaliar o grau de internalização da cultura de riscos nas diretorias/áreas e suas equipes, avaliando se os riscos são de fato conhecidos, debatidos e priorizados em suas rotinas;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente na construção de uma metodologia unificada de gestão de riscos, respeitando a complexidade da matriz Unicred e promovendo alinhamento transversal entre as áreas;
  • Realizar estudos comparativos, pesquisas e análises de mercado para subsidiar decisões metodológicas e garantir aderência às melhores práticas do setor financeiro e cooperativo;
  • Atuar com visão transversal e capacidade de interlocução com diferentes públicos, promovendo sinergia entre a Diretoria de Riscos e as demais estruturas organizacionais;
  • Mapear tendências, visitar cooperativas e trazer referências práticas que promovam inovação, oxigenação e diferenciação para a atuação da Diretoria;
  • Conduzir estudos de benchmark e análise de boas práticas nacionais e internacionais.

Requirements and skills

  • Vivência em apresentações para Diretorias;
  • Domínio em Excel e Power BI – Relatórios Gerenciais;
  • Contabilidade/OKRs – elaboração de relatórios gerenciais;
  • Vivência com gerenciamento e cultura de Riscos;
  • Experiência em Sistema Cooperativista (desejável);
  • Formação em Administração, Economia ou áreas afins.

  • Day Off no aniversário de filhos;
  • Licenças Parentais Estendidas;
  • No Dress Code.

Premissas exclusivas para colaboradores da Unicred:

  • Atenção aos requisitos mínimos da vaga: confira se você atende às qualificações necessárias antes de se candidatar;

Responsabilidade do cargo

Executar o plano operacional de colheita da fazenda sob sua responsabilidade, visando atender o planejamento corporativo, através do cumprimento das programações (talhão a ser colhido, volume a ser entregue, variedade e qualidade da fruta, logística das turmas nas fazendas, entre outros), bem como assegurar a colheita de frutas dentro das especificações e atender as intempéries (fruta cristalizando, queda, greening, entre outros).

  8. Fazer cumprir a correta utilização dos EPI’s, materiais de colheita, bins, carro, máquinas de carregamento e movimentação, instruindo a equipe sempre que necessário.
  9. Treinar e orientar a equipe no que se refere ao processo operacional da colheita, alinhado ao plano de treinamento, normas de segurança, procedimentos internos e legislação vigente.
  10. Executar e auditar o procedimento de sinalização e liberação de banca da colheita para a área de carregamento, conforme normas internas preestabelecidas.

This will entail engagement with Issuers and Dealers to source and validate data, close collaboration with the data engineers on the team to ensure automated processes work as expected, provide support to clients with complex data queries, and work on various data quality and data modeling projects. Joining the Data department means that you are a part of one of the world's leading sources of data, providing accurate, immediate insights for financial market professionals. You will enhance your product knowledge, learn about our clients and their needs, and build relationships throughout the company, all while helping our clients stay on top of developments within Money Markets globally.

You're the type of person who looks beyond the headline with a keen eye for detail because you know how data inspires market trends, breaking news, and analysis. With ever-increasing coverage and demand for timely data, you will be responsible for managing priorities of different initiatives and for utilizing industry knowledge to help drive decisions and generate new dataset offerings. You will need to know your customer, their challenges, and their workflows. With this insight, you will bring creative ideas to the table on how we can make our data integration seamless and more efficient.

We’ll trust you to:

  1. Have knowledge in Fixed income and an interest in Money Markets specifically.
